rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who, even here, knows the end of his suffering, has put down his burden, and is unshackled.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana whose knowledge is deep, who possesses wisdom, who knows the right way and the wrong, and has attained the highest end.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who keeps aloof both from laymen and from mendicants, who frequents no houses, and has but few desires.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who finds no fault with other beings, whether feeble or strong, and does not kill nor cause slaughter.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who is tolerant with the intolerant, mild with fault-finders, and free from passion among the passionate.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana from whom anger and hatred, pride and envy have dropt like a mustard seed from the point of a needle.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
theme_evidence: Văn bản tôn giáo/đạo đức cần giữ ngữ cảnh; không tự biến thành quy luật tâm lý hoặc cam kết kết quả.
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who utters true speech, instructive and free from harshness, so that he offend no one.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who takes nothing in the world that is not given him, be it long or short, small or large, good or bad.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who fosters no desires for this world or for the next, has no inclinations, and is unshackled.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who has no interests, and when he has understood (the truth), does not say How, how? and who has reached the depth of the Immortal.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who in this world is above good and evil, above the bondage of both, free from grief from sin, and from impurity.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who is bright like the moon, pure, serene, undisturbed, and in whom all gaiety is extinct.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who has traversed this miry road, the impassable world and its vanity, who has gone through, and reached the other shore, is thoughtful, guileless, free from doubts, free from attachment, and content.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who in this world, leaving all desires, travels about without a home, and in whom all concupiscence is extinct.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who, leaving all longings, travels about without a home, and in whom all covetousness is extinct.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who, after leaving all bondage to men, has risen above all bondage to the gods, and is free from all and every bondage.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who has left what gives pleasure and what gives pain, who is cold, and free from all germs (of renewed life), the hero who has conquered all the worlds.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who knows the destruction and the return of beings everywhere, who is free from bondage, welfaring (Sugata), and awakened (Buddha).
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana whose path the gods do not know, nor spirits (Gandharvas), nor men, whose passions are extinct, and who is an Arhat (venerable).
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who calls nothing his own, whether it be before, behind, or between, who is poor, and free from the love of the world.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana, the manly, the noble, the hero, the great sage, the conqueror, the impassible, the accomplished, the awakened.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Him I call indeed a Brahmana who knows his former abodes, who sees heaven and hell, has reached the end of births, is perfect in knowledge, a sage, and whose perfections are all perfect.
rows.author: Dhammapada; translated by F. Max Müller
rows.rights_status_observed: F. Max Müller translation is public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text:
Trăm năm trong cõi người ta,
Chữ tài chữ mệnh khéo là ghét nhau.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lạ gì bỉ sắc tư phong,
Trời xanh quen thói má hồng đánh ghen.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Cảo thơm lần giở trước đèn,
Phong tình cổ lục còn truyền sử xanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Rằng năm Gia Tĩnh triều Minh,
Bốn phương phẳng lặng, hai kinh vững vàng.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Có nhà viên ngoại họ Vương,
Gia tư nghĩ cũng thường thường bực trung.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Một trai con thứ rốt lòng,
Vương Quan là chữ, nối dòng nho gia.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đầu lòng hai ả tố nga,
Thúy Kiều là chị, em là Thúy Vân.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Mai cốt cách, tuyết tinh thần,
Một người một vẻ, mười phân vẹn mười.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Vân xem trang trọng khác vời,
Khuôn trăng đầy đặn, nét ngài nở nang.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Hoa cười ngọc thốt đoan trang,
Mây thua nước tóc, tuyết nhường màu da.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Kiều càng sắc sảo, mặn mà,
So bề tài, sắc, lại là phần hơn.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Làn thu thủy, nét xuân sơn,
Hoa ghen thua thắm, liễu hờn kém xanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Một, hai nghiêng nước nghiêng thành,
Sắc đành đòi một, tài đành họa hai.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Thông minh vốn sẵn tư trời,
Pha nghề thi họa, đủ mùi ca ngâm.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Cung thương làu bậc ngũ âm,
Nghề riêng ăn đứt Hồ cầm một trương.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Khúc nhà tay lựa nên chương,
Một thiên bạc mệnh, lại càng não nhân.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Phong lưu rất mực hồng quần,
Xuân xanh xấp xỉ tới tuần cập kê
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Êm đềm trướng rủ màn che,
Tường đông ong bướm đi về mặc ai.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Thanh minh trong tiết tháng ba,
Lễ là tảo mộ, hội là đạp Thanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Gần xa nô nức yến anh,
Chị em sắm sửa bộ hành chơi xuân.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Dập dìu tài tử, giai nhân,
Ngựa xe như nước áo quần như nêm.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Ngổn ngang gò đống kéo lên,
Thoi vàng vó rắc tro tiền giấy bay.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Tà tà bóng ngả về tây,
Chị em thơ thẩn dan tay ra về.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Bước dần theo ngọn tiểu khê,
Lần xem phong cảnh có bề thanh thanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nao nao dòng nước uốn quanh,
Dịp cầu nho nhỏ cuối ghềnh bắc ngang.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Sè sè nấm đất bên đàng,
Dàu dàu ngọn cỏ nửa vàng nửa xanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Rằng: Sao trong tiết thanh minh,
Mà đây hương khói vắng tanh thế mà?
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Vương Quan mới dẫn gần xa:
Đạm Tiên nàng ấy xưa là ca nhi.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nổi danh tài sắc một thì,
Xôn xao ngoài cửa hiếm gì yến anh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Kiếp hồng nhan có mong manh,
Nửa chừng xuân thoắt gãy cành thiên hương.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Có người khách ở viễn phương,
Xa nghe cũng nức tiếng nàng tìm chơi.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Thuyền tình vừa ghé tới nơi,
Thì đà trâm gẫy bình rơi bao giờ.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Buồng không lạnh ngắt như tờ,
Dấu xe ngựa đã rêu lờ mờ xanh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Khóc than khôn xiết sự tình,
Khéo vô duyên ấy là mình với ta.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đã không duyên trước chăng mà,
Thì chi chút ước gọi là duyên sau.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Sắm xanh nếp tử xe trâu
Vùi nông một nấm mặc dầu cỏ hoa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Trải bao thỏ lặn ác tà,
Ấy mồ vô chủ, ai mà viếng thăm!
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lòng đâu sẵn mối thương tâm,
Thoắt nghe Kiều đã đầm đầm châu sa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Phũ phàng chi bấy hóa công,
Ngày xanh mòn mỏi má hồng phôi pha.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Sống làm vợ khắp người ta,
Khéo thay thác xuống làm ma không chồng.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nào người phượng chạ loan chung,
Nào người tích lục tham hồng là ai?
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đã không kẻ đoái người hoài,
Sẵn đây ta kiếm một vài nén hương.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Gọi là gặp gỡ giữa đường,
Họa là người dưới suối vàng biết cho.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lầm rầm khấn khứa nhỏ to,
Sụp ngồi vài gật trước mồ bước ra.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Một vùng cỏ áy bóng tà,
Gió hiu hiu thổi một vài bông lau.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Rút trâm sẵn giắt mái đầu,
Vạch da cây vịnh bốn câu ba vần.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lại càng mê mẩn tâm thần
Lại càng đứng lặng tần ngần chẳng ra.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lại càng ủ dột nét hoa,
Sầu tuôn đứt nối, châu sa vắn dài.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Vân rằng: Chị cũng nực cười,
Khéo dư nước mắt khóc người đời xưa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Rằng: Hồng nhan tự thuở xưa,
Cái điều bạc mệnh có chừa ai đâu?
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nỗi niềm tưởng đến mà đau,
Thấy người nằm đó biết sau thế nào?
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Quan rằng: Chị nói hay sao,
Một lời là một vận vào khó nghe.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Ở đây âm khí nặng nề,
Bóng chiều đã ngả dậm về còn xa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Kiều rằng: Những đấng tài hoa,
Thác là thể phách, còn là tinh anh,
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Dễ hay tình lại gặp tình,
Chờ xem ắt thấy hiển linh bây giờ.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Một lời nói chửa kịp thưa,
Thoắt đâu trận gió cuốn cờ đến ngay.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Ào ào đổ lộc rung cây,
Ở trong dường có hương bay ít nhiều.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đè chừng ngọn gió lần theo,
Dấu giày từng bước in rêu rành rành.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Mắt nhìn ai nấy đều kinh,
Nàng rằng: Này thực tinh thành chẳng xa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Hữu tình ta lại gặp ta,
Chớ nề u hiển mới là chị em.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đã lòng hiển hiện cho xem,
Tạ lòng nàng lại nối thêm vài lời.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Lòng thơ lai láng bồi hồi,
Gốc cây lại vạch một bài cổ thi.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Dùng dằng nửa ở nửa về,
Nhạc vàng đâu đã tiếng nghe gần gần.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Trông chừng thấy một văn nhân,
Lỏng buông tay khấu bước lần dặm băng.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Đề huề lưng túi gió trăng,
Sau chân theo một vài thằng con con.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Tuyết in sắc ngựa câu giòn,
Cỏ pha màu áo nhuộm non da trời.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nẻo xa mới tỏ mặt người,
Khách đà xuống ngựa tới nơi tự tình.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Hài văn lần bước dặm xanh,
Một vùng như thể cây quỳnh cành dao.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Chàng Vương quen mặt ra chào,
Hai Kiều e lệ nép vào dưới hoa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nguyên người quanh quất đâu xa,
Họ Kim tên Trọng vốn nhà trâm anh.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nền phú hậu, bậc tài danh,
Văn chương nết đất, thông minh tính trời.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Phong tư tài mạo tót vời,
Vào trong phong nhã, ra ngoài hào hoa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Chung quanh vẫn đất nước nhà,
Với Vương Quan trước vẫn là đồng thân.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Vẫn nghe thơm nức hương lân,
Một nền đồng Tước khóa xuân hai Kiều.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Nước non cách mấy buồng thêu,
Những là trộm nhớ thầm yêu chốc mòng.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
May thay giải cấu tương phùng,
Gặp tuần đố lá thỏa lòng tìm hoa.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Bóng hồng nhác thấy nẻo xa,
Xuân lan thu cúc mặn mà cả hai.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Chập chờn cơn tỉnh cơn mê.
Rốn ngồi chẳng tiện, dứt về chỉn khôn.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Bóng tà như giục cơn buồn,
Khách đà lên ngựa, người còn nghé theo.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Dưới cầu nước chảy trong veo,
Bên cầu tơ liễu bóng chiều thướt tha.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Kiều từ trở gót trướng hoa,
Mặt trời gác núi chiêng đà thu không.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Gương nga chênh chếch dòm song,
Vàng gieo ngấn nước, cây lồng bóng sân.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du
rows.rights_status_observed: Wikisource marks the work public domain; reuse must preserve edition/transcription provenance and Wikisource licensing where applicable.

rows.text:
Hải đường lả ngọn đông lân,
Giọt sương gieo nặng cành xuân la đà.
rows.author: Nguyễn Du

rows.text:
Một mình lặng ngắm bóng nga,
Rộn đường gần với nỗi xa bời bời:
rows.author: Nguyễn Du

rows.text:
Người mà đến thế thì thôi,
Đời phồn hoa cũng là đời bỏ đi!
rows.author: Nguyễn Du

rows.text:
Chênh chênh bóng nguyệt xế mành,
Tựa nương bên triện một mình thiu thiu.

Thoắt đâu thấy một tiểu kiều,

rows.author: Nguyễn Du

Sương in mặt, tuyết pha thân,

rows.text:
Chào mừng đón hỏi dò la:

Mới cùng nhau lúc ban ngày đã quên.

Hàn gia ở mé tây thiên,

Mấy lòng hạ cố đến nhau,

Vâng trình hội chủ xem tường,

rows.text:
Âu đành quả kiếp nhân duyên,
Cùng người một hội, một thuyền đâu xa!

rows.text: In the preface to that admirable collection of essays of his called 'Heretics,' Mr.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Chesterton writes these words: "There are some people--and I am one of them--who think that the most practical and important thing about a man is still his view of the universe.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: We think that for a landlady considering a lodger, it is important to know his income, but still more important to know his philosophy.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: We think that for a general about to fight an enemy, it is important to know the enemy's numbers, but still more important to know the enemy's philosophy.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: We think the question is not whether the theory of the cosmos affects matters, but whether, in the long run, anything else affects them."
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I know that you, ladies and gentlemen, have a philosophy, each and all of you, and that the most interesting and important thing about you is the way in which it determines the perspective in your several worlds.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: And yet I confess to a certain tremor at the audacity of the enterprise which I am about to begin.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: For the philosophy which is so important in each of us is not a technical matter; it is our more or less dumb sense of what life honestly and deeply means.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It is only partly got from books; it is our individual way of just seeing and feeling the total push and pressure of the cosmos.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I have no right to assume that many of you are students of the cosmos in the class-room sense, yet here I stand desirous of interesting you in a philosophy which to no small extent has to be technically treated.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I wish to fill you with sympathy with a contemporaneous tendency in which I profoundly believe, and yet I have to talk like a professor to you who are not students.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Whatever universe a professor believes in must at any rate be a universe that lends itself to lengthy discourse.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: A universe definable in two sentences is something for which the professorial intellect has no use.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I have heard friends and colleagues try to popularize philosophy in this very hall, but they soon grew dry, and then technical, and the results were only partially encouraging.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The founder of pragmatism himself recently gave a course of lectures at the Lowell Institute with that very word in its title-flashes of brilliant light relieved against Cimmerian darkness!
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: None of us, I fancy, understood ALL that he said--yet here I stand, making a very similar venture.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I risk it because the very lectures I speak of DREW--they brought good audiences.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: There is, it must be confessed, a curious fascination in hearing deep things talked about, even tho neither we nor the disputants understand them.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: We get the problematic thrill, we feel the presence of the vastness.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Let a controversy begin in a smoking-room anywhere, about free-will or God's omniscience, or good and evil, and see how everyone in the place pricks up his ears.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Philosophy's results concern us all most vitally, and philosophy's queerest arguments tickle agreeably our sense of subtlety and ingenuity.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Believing in philosophy myself devoutly, and believing also that a kind of new dawn is breaking upon us philosophers, I feel impelled, per fas aut nefas, to try to impart to you some news of the situation.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Philosophy is at once the most sublime and the most trivial of human pursuits.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It works in the minutest crannies and it opens out the widest vistas.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It 'bakes no bread,' as has been said, but it can inspire our souls with courage; and repugnant as its manners, its doubting and challenging, its quibbling and dialectics, often are to common people, no one of us can get along without the far-flashing beams of light it sends over the world's perspectives.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: These illuminations at least, and the contrast-effects of darkness and mystery that accompany them, give to what it says an interest that is much more than professional.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The history of philosophy is to a great extent that of a certain clash of human temperaments.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Undignified as such a treatment may seem to some of my colleagues, I shall have to take account of this clash and explain a good many of the divergencies of philosophers by it.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Of whatever temperament a professional philosopher is, he tries when philosophizing to sink the fact of his temperament.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Temperament is no conventionally recognized reason, so he urges impersonal reasons only for his conclusions.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Yet his temperament really gives him a stronger bias than any of his more strictly objective premises.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It loads the evidence for him one way or the other, making for a more sentimental or a more hard-hearted view of the universe, just as this fact or that principle would.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Wanting a universe that suits it, he believes in any representation of the universe that does suit it.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: He feels men of opposite temper to be out of key with the world's character, and in his heart considers them incompetent and 'not in it,' in the philosophic business, even tho they may far excel him in dialectical ability.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Yet in the forum he can make no claim, on the bare ground of his temperament, to superior discernment or authority.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: There arises thus a certain insincerity in our philosophic discussions: the potentest of all our premises is never mentioned.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I am sure it would contribute to clearness if in these lectures we should break this rule and mention it, and I accordingly feel free to do so.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Of course I am talking here of very positively marked men, men of radical idiosyncracy, who have set their stamp and likeness on philosophy and figure in its history.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Plato, Locke, Hegel, Spencer, are such temperamental thinkers.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Most of us have, of course, no very definite intellectual temperament, we are a mixture of opposite ingredients, each one present very moderately.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: We hardly know our own preferences in abstract matters; some of us are easily talked out of them, and end by following the fashion or taking up with the beliefs of the most impressive philosopher in our neighborhood, whoever he may be.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: But the one thing that has COUNTED so far in philosophy is that a man should see things, see them straight in his own peculiar way, and be dissatisfied with any opposite way of seeing them.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: There is no reason to suppose that this strong temperamental vision is from now onward to count no longer in the history of man's beliefs.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Now the particular difference of temperament that I have in mind in making these remarks is one that has counted in literature, art, government and manners as well as in philosophy.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: You recognize these contrasts as familiar; well, in philosophy we have a very similar contrast expressed in the pair of terms 'rationalist' and 'empiricist,' 'empiricist' meaning your lover of facts in all their crude variety, 'rationalist' meaning your devotee to abstract and eternal principles.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: No one can live an hour without both facts and principles, so it is a difference rather of emphasis; yet it breeds antipathies of the most pungent character between those who lay the emphasis differently; and we shall find it extraordinarily convenient to express a certain contrast in men's ways of taking their universe, by talking of the 'empiricist' and of the 'rationalist' temper.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: More simple and massive than are usually the men of whom the terms are predicated.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: For every sort of permutation and combination is possible in human nature; and if I now proceed to define more fully what I have in mind when I speak of rationalists and empiricists, by adding to each of those titles some secondary qualifying characteristics, I beg you to regard my conduct as to a certain extent arbitrary.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I select types of combination that nature offers very frequently, but by no means uniformly, and I select them solely for their convenience in helping me to my ulterior purpose of characterizing pragmatism.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Historically we find the terms 'intellectualism' and 'sensationalism' used as synonyms of 'rationalism' and 'empiricism.' Well, nature seems to combine most frequently with intellectualism an idealistic and optimistic tendency.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Empiricists on the other hand are not uncommonly materialistic, and their optimism is apt to be decidedly conditional and tremulous.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It starts from wholes and universals, and makes much of the unity of things.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Empiricism starts from the parts, and makes of the whole a collection-is not averse therefore to calling itself pluralistic.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Rationalism usually considers itself more religious than empiricism, but there is much to say about this claim, so I merely mention it.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It is a true claim when the individual rationalist is what is called a man of feeling, and when the individual empiricist prides himself on being hard-headed.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: In that case the rationalist will usually also be in favor of what is called free-will, and the empiricist will be a fatalist--I use the terms most popularly current.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The rationalist finally will be of dogmatic temper in his affirmations, while the empiricist may be more sceptical and open to discussion.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: I think you will practically recognize the two types of mental make-up that I mean if I head the columns by the titles 'tender-minded' and 'tough-minded' respectively.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Rationalistic (going by 'principles'), Intellectualistic, Idealistic, Optimistic, Religious, Free-willist, Monistic, Dogmatical.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Empiricist (going by 'facts'), Sensationalistic, Materialistic, Pessimistic, Irreligious, Fatalistic, Pluralistic, Sceptical.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Pray postpone for a moment the question whether the two contrasted mixtures which I have written down are each inwardly coherent and self-consistent or not--I shall very soon have a good deal to say on that point.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It suffices for our immediate purpose that tender-minded and tough-minded people, characterized as I have written them down, do both exist.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Each of you probably knows some well-marked example of each type, and you know what each example thinks of the example on the other side of the line.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Their antagonism, whenever as individuals their temperaments have been intense, has formed in all ages a part of the philosophic atmosphere of the time.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The tough think of the tender as sentimentalists and soft-heads.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The tender feel the tough to be unrefined, callous, or brutal.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Their mutual reaction is very much like that that takes place when Bostonian tourists mingle with a population like that of Cripple Creek.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Each type believes the other to be inferior to itself; but disdain in the one case is mingled with amusement, in the other it has a dash of fear.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Now, as I have already insisted, few of us are tender-foot Bostonians pure and simple, and few are typical Rocky Mountain toughs, in philosophy.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Most of us have a hankering for the good things on both sides of the line.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The world is indubitably one if you look at it in one way, but as indubitably is it many, if you look at it in another.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: It is both one and many--let us adopt a sort of pluralistic monism.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: Everything of course is necessarily determined, and yet of course our wills are free: a sort of free-will determinism is the true philosophy.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.

rows.text: The evil of the parts is undeniable; but the whole can't be evil: so practical pessimism may be combined with metaphysical optimism.
rows.author: William James
rows.work: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
rows.rights_status_observed: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg record; jurisdiction review required for redistribution.
